cast.narrator: Male, 45-60, deep, slow, grave American true-crime documentary narrator. Deadpan. Never jokes; every line delivered with total seriousness.
cast.giga: Male, 25-35, deep, confident, relaxed gym-bro. Smug and sincere.
cast.wojak: Male, 20-30, higher and thinner voice, sad, fragile, on the verge of tears.
cast.whale: Male, 55-70, wealthy, refined, unhurried; speaks like a man reading a statement prepared by lawyers.
cast.pepe: Male, 30-40, fast, intense, conspiratorial; barely containing excitement.
cast.bonk: Male, any age, flat and blunt; one word.
cast.troll: Male, 20-35, gleeful, mischievous, far too pleased with himself.
cast.mom: Female, 50-60, warm, cheerful, slightly distracted mother.
